phases.note: Initial run interrupted for implementation updates. Two active sessions were terminated before their final rows; usage for them is unavailable. No Jev calls were active in that block.
Resume skipped valid identities, retried invalid ones, then completed the remaining model/arm blocks.
Final runner retried the two invalid DeepSeek preselect identities; both passed.

notes: This is a plumbing pilot, not held-out evidence for routing quality.
Only completed model-request counters are known. The first phase discarded partial usage on timeout; its invalid usage is a lower bound.
Invalid attempts stay out of quality denominators.
All recorded cache writes were zero.
Size-sweep break-even and quality retention are not shown.

pooledTotals.method: Group all recorded attempts by model and arm; sort models lexically and arms in core-arm order (bare, skills-all, mcp-all, all, gateway, preselect). Count attempts and each result; sum steps.length and totals.input, cacheRead, cacheWrite, output and reasoning.
pooledTotals.splitPolicy: These operational totals pool dev and test and include completed counters from invalid attempts. Use summary.md for split-separated quality and cost analysis; never tune from these pooled totals.

historicalLibrary.selection: Ambient configured loadout library; not an explicit --library argument.
historicalLibrary.limitation: Counts were retained in controlled runner logs. Per-skill origins, source revisions, exact accepted names and original content were not captured at run time; the intended public corpus cannot be verified retrospectively.

historicalIsolation.network: Shared host network, including unrelated loopback listeners. New runs require pasta isolation.
historicalIsolation.nodeChecks: Legacy exit-code grading could accept an early module exit before assertions. New runs require expected test-case completion evidence.
historicalIsolation.resume: Use a fresh output directory with the new harness; legacy protocol and unknown library fingerprints cannot be resumed as equivalent.
